comment: The drive gain is 0.2 times one plus 25 times the knob (Fil.cpp:127, :29), so 0.2 to 5.2 with 1.45 at the default knob position. The waveshaper adds a quarter of the square of the signal before a tanh (Fil.cpp:152 to :158), and the DC blocker corner is 2.25Hz (Fil.cpp:64). The maker's light tooltips are jokes rather than descriptions: "Hungry, feed me!", "Moderate filing.." and "Serious grinding going on..".
